0.0.n: Together with ８月, this specifies a month recurring each year.

0.1.n: A number followed by 月 names a calendar month; the eighth month is August.

1.0.n: This is a place name; 県 identifies it as a prefecture.

1.1.n: Links 新潟県 to 中央, showing which area's center is meant.

1.2.n: Softens 中央: the city is near the center, not necessarily at the exact center.

1.3.n: Refers to the geographical middle of Niigata Prefecture.

1.4.n: Marks the location described by 位置する.

1.5.n: 位置 + する forms a verb; its plain form directly describes the following city name.

1.6.n: This is a place name; 市 identifies it as a city.

1.7.n: Marks the destination where people gather; it connects to 集まります in the next line.

2.0.n: 万 means ten thousand, so 100万 is one million; 人 counts people.

2.1.n: Follows a quantity and includes that quantity as the minimum.

2.2.n: Marks 100万人以上 as the people doing the gathering.

2.3.n: Polite form of 集まる; here it describes a recurring event rather than an action happening right now.

0.tip: 毎年８月 means every August; no particle is needed here to set the time.

1.lit: In Nagaoka City, which is located almost in the center of Niigata Prefecture,
1.tip: Japanese puts the description ほぼ中央に位置する before the city name it describes.

2.lit: One million people or more gather.
2.tip: 以上 includes the stated number, so the precise meaning is one million or more, not strictly more than one million.
